description: Lists the internet exchanges (IXs) where NetActuate offers colocation, bare metal, virtual machines or remote peering, for example AMS-IX, DE-CIX and LINX. With no query it returns every exchange NetActuate publishes a page for; each result gives the slug, name, description, the opening paragraph of its page and its netactuate.com URL. Use it for peering and interconnection questions, such as 'does NetActuate peer at DE-CIX' or 'which exchanges offer remote peering'. Exchange pages name cities, not regions, so filter by city or exchange. A query also returns namedOnDataCenterPages: the data centers whose own pages name a matching exchange, with those lines, which covers exchanges without a page of their own (NL-IX at Amsterdam, JPNAP at Tokyo). For an exchange's full page use get_netactuate_page; for the data centers themselves, list_data_centers.

query.description: Words that must all appear on the exchange's page: an exchange or city name, or a service, e.g. 'DE-CIX', 'Frankfurt', 'remote peering'.

name: list_internet_exchanges
title: List internet exchange presence
